body:
Adds `v_max` to `Chen2022VelTypeSmallIce` and applies the smooth bound used for rain and snow to the cloud ice `MicrophysicsNonEq.terminal_velocity`, so that downstream models need no cap of their own. The bound moves to `Common.bounded_fall_speed`, shared by both modules; the per-particle `v_term(D)` used by P3 is unchanged.

`v_max` for small ice is read from the ClimaParams entry `Chen2022_small_ice_terminal_velocity_max` (1.5 m/s), added in https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaParams.jl/pull/350 and analogous to `Chen2022_large_ice_terminal_velocity_max`. This PR requires ClimaParams 1.3.14.

The 1-moment docs now give the Chen et al. (2022) group velocity of rain and snow in terms of the diameter slope `λ / 2` and with the bound. The version is bumped to 0.51.1.
title: Bound the 1M cloud ice terminal velocity
